name: Abracademia
source:
Hey, congrats! After years of studying and training, you managed to land your dream job as a university professor, working under the Faculty of Magic and Alchemy.  The university is considered really prestigious, but the faculty itself isn't really in the land's top 10... The dean wants that to change. This year. No pressure, right?

The task is far from easy, and it will need your undivided attention. But don't worry; if you need help, your fellow professors will be glad to help you. Speaking of that, you'll be sharing an office space with two of the faculty's most attractive guys, but surely someone with your passion for academia won't let that distract them... right?

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/abracademia]itch.io[/url]]
